events.text: Delay in match because of an injury João Gomes (Aston Villa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Aston Villa 1, Viking 0. Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) header from the left side of the six yard box to the top left corner. Assisted by Ibrahim Mbaye with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Aston Villa 2, Viking 0. Emiliano Buendía (Aston Villa) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Own Goal by Henrik Heggheim, Viking. Aston Villa 3, Viking 0.
Substitution, Viking. Henrik Bjørdal replaces Tobias Moi.
Substitution, Viking. Simen Kvia-Egeskog replaces Erik Botheim.
Substitution, Aston Villa. Leon Goretzka replaces Ross Barkley.

Substitution, Viking. Vetle Auklend replaces Zlatko Tripic.
Goal! Aston Villa 3, Viking 1. Peter Christiansen (Viking) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Kristoffer Askildsen.Goal awarded following VAR Review.
Substitution, Viking. Essien Bassey replaces Herman Haugen.
